```json
{
  "winner": "B",
  "reasons": [
    "The goal is one paying customer within 90 days. B names a specific buyer pair, a Wisconsin public adjuster and an affiliated roofing contractor, with a documented pain: manual intake and inconsistent claim documentation. A has no named prospect. Its first customer must come through App Store discovery, which A's own brief calls the bottleneck.",
    "B's willingness to pay is anchored by four direct competitors with sourced pricing between $65 and $250 per month, all charging this exact buyer type. A's anchors are competitors whose traction evidence is weak: Descrii has 0 reviews, Gelo.ai has 3, and Describly has 1 review, rated 1 star.",
    "A's core use case, plain description generation, is offered free by Shopify Magic to every paid-plan merchant. That shrinks A's paying segment to alt text, bulk, and vision use cases. In those, AltText.ai already holds 141 reviews and a Built for Shopify badge.",
    "B's main drawbacks are a market of only 188 Wisconsin licensees, scope creep toward full claim-lifecycle features, and data-security compliance. These threaten scale and the build timeline more than they threaten landing a first paying customer. A's drawbacks, saturation, a free native substitute, and one-time-per-catalog need, threaten both acquisition and retention.",
    "A's acquisition evidence is thin. The low-CPI claim is a single developer anecdote, Firepush. Organic ranking is described as difficult for new entrants without reviews."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "A's urgency case for alt text rests on ADA settlement figures ($25k–$75k) and a '77% of ADA lawsuits target online stores' statistic. Both come from vendor and marketing blogs (goodysell.com, compliapoint.com) that have an incentive to inflate compliance fear. A's demand quotes are also weak. The three generic Reddit comments say description writing is tedious, but none shows willingness to pay, especially when Shopify Magic is free.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate confidence. B's decisive advantage is the named customer pair, but B's own brief lists as an open question whether that commitment is real or informal. Its demand quotes come from a Florida firm and a Reddit post, not from the named customer. If the relationship is informal, B's edge largely disappears and the two ideas are closer. Even then, B still faces data-security and breach-notification compliance work before it can handle live claimant PII inside the 90-day window."
}
```
